title: Dormant Cancer Cells Evade Immune System by Changing Shape in Mouse Model
summary: Cancer cells that disseminate from a tumor can enter a period of dormancy that may persist from months to decades before metastasis. Stopping cancer cells from entering a soft biomechanical state could help the immune system clear dormant cancer.The postDormant Cancer Cells Evade Immune System by Changing Shape in Mouse Modelappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
